title: Taming the Wild in Impartial Combinatorial Games
notes: Introduces the misere indistinguishability quotient as a commutative monoid. Theorem 1 gives the complete 20-element presentation of octal 0.123: generators x,z,a,b with x^2=a^2=1, z^4=z^2, b^4=b^2, abz=b, b^3x=b^2, z^3a=z^2; P-set {x, xa, b^2, z^2, zb}; periodic pretending function of period 5 after preperiod 5. This is the Phase-0 validation target. The construction G ≡ H iff o^-(G+X)=o^-(H+X) for every context X is KNOWN.
